scope: Targeted workaround for YulOptimizerKnowledgeBaseStaleBookkeeping in new compilations: Solidity 0.8.37 default Yul optimizer sequence minus E and L only. This is a bytecode-changing compiler profile and requires fresh exact-source qualification and a new deployment; it does not alter or repair existing deployed bytecode.

hardhat/hardhat.config.js.purpose: Retain Solidity 0.8.37 and the existing via-IR, runs and EVM settings; explicitly use its default Yul sequence with E (EqualStoreEliminator) and L (LoadResolver) removed to mitigate SOL-2026-7 for new compilation.

foundry.toml.purpose: Apply the same targeted SOL-2026-7 Yul optimizer mitigation as Hardhat, retaining the existing compiler version and all other profile settings.

scripts/security/run-slither-extended.sh.purpose: Re-run complete current-source Slither analysis deterministically with all 102 detectors and the focused 6-detector reentrancy scan; clean preliminary build outputs before collecting full compiler input/output and retain raw findings for strict verification.
